data.why: CesiumAstro announced a new manufacturing facility in Melbourne, Florida less than a month ago. For a vertically integrated space hardware maker, opening a new production site creates immediate operational work for accounting around equipment orders and supplier onboarding.
data.angle: Reviewing, approving, and matching new equipment purchase orders and local supplier invoices for the new facility.

not_chosen.reason: Awkward: CesiumAstro is hiring for Sanjiv's own title (Corporate Controller).
Bad news: Headline notes satellite hardware supply chains are struggling to keep up.
Funding amounts disagree across sources ($630M in s7 vs $730M in s11-s18) and funding announcements are overused by reps.
Role tenure is 315 days old and states Sanjiv's own background back to him.
Headcount growth (+60%) is generic compared to the specific new manufacturing plant expansion.

data.subject: melbourne facility
data.body:
Hi Sanjiv,

CesiumAstro is adding a manufacturing facility in Melbourne, Florida.

Setting up a new facility usually brings a wave of new supplier invoices and equipment purchase orders. Who is matching all those new bills today?

Mindbody processes 95%+ of invoices end to end with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
